evidenceType: offline maintenance validation plus separate cloud publication verification
publicationStatus: public latest build and source hashes verified separately from offline tests
sourceReachability: not tested by these offline checks

authorTests.scope: 14 existing reputation/history tests plus 25 maintenance regressions and healthy controls

independentFinalCheckGroups.scope: two post-review identity repairs and focused healthy controls

repairs: Distinct same-platform branches sharing a website receive separate automatic source-profile identities.
Different explicit business-group keys cannot merge directly or through an unkeyed bridge; the same group still combines known sources.
Legacy previousDatasetId/history baselines use source-profile evidence instead of aggregate entityKey alone; ambiguous/conflicting/invalid-clock baselines are incomplete.
An incomplete prior snapshot suppresses numeric deltas and false addition/recovery claims.
Known incomplete peers and their reconstructed raw profile rows are excluded from ready benchmark cohorts; duplicate old/new keys cannot inflate the same-profile cohort.
compatibilityLimits: Automatic entityKey values migrate; explicit sourceBusinessKey hashes remain stable.
A preferred source/ID change can change an automatic key. Contradictory nonempty IDs/URLs conservatively withhold the comparison, including a URL rename with the same ID.
Unambiguous ID-less legacy rows can still match by profile URL.
Known partial records are excluded; a profile-only supplied benchmark retains its previous supplied-row behavior.
Existing history/benchmark read caps and source matching heuristics remain. Offline checks are not broad entity-resolution or source reliability proof.
baselineUse: Immutable build 0.3.10 is the local QA reference, not a byte-for-byte snapshot of the complete current editable source version.
releaseSourceScope: Reviewed runtime modules and the existing reputation test fixture overlaid the current editable source. Existing editable dependencies and non-runtime files were preserved; no dependency pin changes were made. The immutable QA baseline does not establish complete current editable byte parity.
